lines.text: Many learners say: I want a coffee, please.
Better: I would like a coffee, please.
Would like is more polite here.
Would like! I would like some water, please.

data.right: I would like a coffee, please.
data.why: Would like is more polite here.

quiz.stem: Be polite: I ___ some water, please.

native.hook: 点东西用 would like 更礼貌！
native.tip: 中文点东西说“我要一杯咖啡”很自然。英语里 I want 听起来比较直接，在店里点东西更礼貌的说法是 I would like。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I want a coffee, please.”😅 中文说“我要”很自然，英语用 would like 更礼貌：“I would like a coffee, please.”跟着 Ama 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。

en.tip: Ordering with I want is normal in Chinese, but in English it can sound a little direct. I would like is more polite.
en.caption: Do you say “I want a coffee, please.” 😅 In English, I want can sound a little direct: “I would like a coffee, please.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
